post_topic: LLM-agnostic architecture as the answer to vendor lock-in gaps in enterprise AI stacks
scene_description: A technical architecture diagram showing a routing/abstraction layer sitting between an application's orchestration logic and three LLM provider endpoints — OpenAI GPT-4o, Anthropic Claude 3.5 Sonnet, and Google Gemini 1.5 Pro — with a 'provider interface' boundary clearly marked that the application code never crosses directly. On one side of the diagram, labeled 'hardcoded native SDK path,' direct wires connect application logic straight to a single deprecated model endpoint with red warning indicators showing broken evals and embedding drift. On the other side, labeled 'Cloud Decoded architecture,' a normalized routing layer with tenant-scoped HITL policy configs fans out cleanly to any provider behind a typed schema contract, visually surviving the model deprecation that broke the first path.
